ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: In the diagram showing terrestrial food chain, which organism is the original producer?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The left side of the image is labeled “A terrestrial food chain”; from bottom to top it sequentially shows and is labeled as Plant, Grasshopper, Mouse, Snake, Hawk, with arrows pointing upward from the Plant at the bottom toward the subsequent organisms, indicating that energy is transferred upward along the food chain. Reasoning: The original producer in the food chain is the autotrophic organism located at the lowest level, able to make its own nutrients through methods such as photosynthesis and provide energy for consumers. The bottom of the left terrestrial food chain is Plant, therefore the original producer is Plant.
